support_text: Based on its profile, 36 (AZD9898) has progressed into phase 1 clinical development. Overall, single doses of 36 were well tolerated, and no safety concerns were raised. Measurement of urinary LTE4 (uLTE4) normalized to creatinine was used as a pharmacodynamic marker. At the highest dose tested (45 mg), 36 reduced uLTE4 levels for 14 h post dose with a maximum reduction at 6 h post dose; the 45 mg dose was the highest possible due to exposure limitation margins. Because the required magnitude and duration of the PD effect were lower than expected and modeling/simulation did not support reaching the required uLTE4 inhibition even with twice daily dosing, the decision was made to stop the multipart Phase I study after the single dose phase. The development of 36 was terminated early in phase 1.
